mapper.insert: insert into shop(name, logo, status, business_hours, phone, address, created_at, updated_at) values(#{name}, #{logo}, #{status}, #{businessHours}, #{phone}, #{address}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update shop set name = #{name}, logo = #{logo}, status = #{status}, business_hours = #{businessHours}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
